biography: Ivan Benvenuti, born in the heart of Modena, Italy, practically inhaled the scent of gasoline before he learned to walk. Growing up a stone's throw from Ferrari's hallowed grounds, his destiny was practically preordained. His father, a mechanic for a small GT racing team, fueled young Ivan's obsession, smuggling him into paddocks and letting him tinker with engines far too complex for his age. A defining moment came at age 16, during an unauthorized (and highly illegal) spin in his father's old Alfa Romeo on a winding mountain road. Exceeding all expectations, he expertly drifted through corners, discovering a raw talent that would soon propel him to the top. Now, at 37, Benvenuti is at the peak of his powers, a force to be reckoned with in the Lamborghini stable, known for his daring overtakes and unrelenting pursuit of victory. He's not just driving; he's conducting a symphony of speed, a maestro behind the wheel.
drivingStyle: Benvenuti's driving style can be best described as 'controlled aggression.' He's a late-braking specialist, unafraid to dive down the inside of even the most seasoned veterans. While some criticize his approach as overly risky, his tire management is surprisingly astute. He pushes the limit without obliterating his tires, allowing him to maintain a blistering pace throughout an entire stint. Under pressure, Benvenuti thrives; the higher the stakes, the more ice seems to flow through his veins, sharpening his focus and amplifying his already formidable skills.

rivalries.reason: A long-standing feud stemming from a controversial collision at Monza in 2021, where Dubois accused Benvenuti of reckless driving.
A clash of personalities; Petrova, known for her calculated approach, sees Benvenuti as a chaotic wildcard, while he views her as overly cautious.
A fierce competition for the Lamborghini team's top spot, fueled by both drivers' ambitions and unwavering belief in their own abilities.

quirks: Always wears the same lucky pair of racing gloves, even though they are falling apart.
Listens to a specific opera aria ('Nessun Dorma') right before every race to calm his nerves.
Refuses to eat anything green on race day, believing it brings bad luck.
famousQuote: Second place is just the first loser. I race to win, nothing else matters.
careerHighlight: Winning the 24 Hours of Daytona in 2022 after a nail-biting final lap overtake, securing his place as a legend in endurance racing.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead at the 2020 Le Mans 24 Hours with only an hour remaining, costing his team a likely victory and leaving him devastated.
